[Advance Base Defender]
This place is too dangerous. Return to the base, now!
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守卫]
这里太危险了。立刻返回基地！

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
I'll see that no monster sneak into the base.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守卫]
我会确保没有魔物潜入基地。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
Sigh, how long do I have to do this?
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守卫]
唉，我还要在这里站多久啊？

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
Don't worry. I'm here to protect you.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守卫]
别担心。我会保护你的。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
We're in the middle of the battlefield. I can't talk for too long.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守卫]
我们正处于战场中心，不能聊太久。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
Please step aside. You're blocking my vision.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守卫]
请让一下。你挡住我的视线了。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
If you have time for chit-chat, then kill one more enemy instead.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守卫]
既然有时间闲聊，不如再去消灭一个敌人。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
Bah, I'm cold and hungry... Oh, I was just talking to myself.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守卫]
真是的，又冷又饿...啊，我刚才是在自言自语。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
Be careful: this place is overrun with dangerous monsters.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守卫]
小心：这里到处都是危险的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
For every monster I kill, one or more appear to take its place.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守卫]
我每消灭一只魔物，就会有一只或更多新的魔物出现。

scripts.text: [Advance Base Defender]
scripts.translation: [前哨基地守卫]

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with the dialogue because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续对话。 -

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
You look super weak!
Why are you here??
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
你看起来好弱啊！
为什么来这里？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Well, there are not enough people!
But we will wait until you reach level 150.
Please come back later!
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
嗯，人手不足！
但我们会等你达到150级。
请稍后再来！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Have you noticed it, too?
Yes, the monsters in this area are really quite strange.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
你也注意到了吗？
是的，这个区域的魔物确实很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
They appear to be mutant versions of Midgard monsters
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
它们似乎是米德加尔特魔物的变异版本。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Worse still, their number has been rapidly increasing.
We must keep an eye on them.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
更糟糕的是，它们的数量正在迅速增加。
我们必须密切关注它们。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
To my regret, everyone seems so busy that I can't ask them for help, despite the seriousness of the investigation.
This is not a safe environment.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
遗憾的是，大家都太忙了，尽管调查工作很紧急，我还是无法请求他们的帮助。
这里的环境并不安全。

scripts.text: What's going on?
scripts.translation: 发生了什么？

scripts.text: Why can't you do it yourself?
scripts.translation: 为什么你自己不做？

scripts.text: Do you want me to do it?
scripts.translation: 你想让我去做吗？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
The environmental characteristics of this area are making the investigation too difficult.
The scenery looks familiar, yet in a way... strange.
The place looks like it's on the verge of utter collapse but.. I can see bursts of vibrant growth.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
这个地区的环境特征让调查变得异常困难。
这里的景色看起来很熟悉，却又透着一种...怪异。
这个地方看起来仿佛随时会彻底崩塌，但...我却又看到了蓬勃的生命力。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
What is this place?
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
这究竟是个什么地方？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Like everyone else from a noble background,
I only know how to command others.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
和所有出身名门的人一样，
我只懂得如何命令别人。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Of all those monsters,
^0000FFFire Condors^000000 look most dangerous.
Those birds with burning tails charge headlong toward everyone they see. You may be able to run from them, but you will always get singed.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
在所有那些魔物中，
^0000FF火焰秃鹰^000000看起来最危险。
那些拖着燃烧尾巴的鸟会径直冲向它们看到的每一个人。你或许能跑开，但一定会被烧焦。

scripts.text: Do you want me to hunt Fire Condors?
scripts.translation: 你想让我去猎杀火焰秃鹰吗？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
No, I have no one to dispose their carcasses.
My purpose is, after all, an investigation.
Just bring me
15 ^FF0000Burning Feathers^000000
from ^0000FFFire Condors^000000.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
不，我没有人手去处理它们的尸体。
毕竟，我的职责是进行调查。
只要从^0000FF火焰秃鹰^000000身上收集
15个^FF0000火焰羽毛^000000带给我就行。

scripts.text: I'm as busy as you!
scripts.translation: 我也和你一样忙！

scripts.text: Got it.
scripts.translation: 明白了。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
You acted as if you'd help me.
Were you messing with me?
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
你刚才表现得好像要帮我一样。
你是在耍我吗？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Bring me
^FF000015 Burning Feathers^000000
from ^0000FFFire Condors^000000.
Hurry before more people fall victim to those vicious birds!
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
从^0000FF火焰秃鹰^000000身上收集
^FF000015个火焰羽毛^000000带给我。
快一点，在更多人成为那些维舍斯鸟类的受害者之前！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
I thought you'd be hard at work by now,
gathering ^FF000015 Burning Feathers^000000
from ^0000FFFire Condors^000000,
so I called an emergency meeting of
my investigators.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
我本以为你现在应该正在努力工作，
从^0000FF火焰秃鹰^000000身上收集^FF000015个火焰羽毛^000000，
所以我召集了我的调查员们开了个紧急会议。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
And you're still in town,
enjoying a leisurely walk.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
而你却还在城镇里，
悠闲地散步。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
You brought
all the ^FF000015 Burning Feathers^000000.
Thank you. Now I can
proceed with my investigation.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
你带来了
全部^FF000015个火焰羽毛^000000。
谢谢。现在我可以
继续我的调查了。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Most of all, I can finally enjoy the warmth of a fire!
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
最重要的是，我终于可以享受篝火的温暖了！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Did you notice the worrisome expression on my face?
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
你注意到我脸上担忧的表情了吗？

scripts.text: Nope. Never.
scripts.translation: 没有。完全没注意到。

scripts.text: I did, instantly.
scripts.translation: 注意到了，立刻就看出来了。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
That's not the answer I expected,
but I'll continue with the spiel
I've prepared.
Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
这不是我预期的回答，
但我还是继续念我准备好的台词吧。
唉...

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
A scout hasn't returned
from the Flaming Basin.
I want you to go check
what happened to him.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
一名侦察兵从烈焰盆地出发后就没有回来。
我想让你去查看一下他发生了什么。

scripts.text: No can do.
scripts.translation: 做不到。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
I know you'll do it anyway!
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
我知道你反正会去做的！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
The scout headed for the area teeming with monsters.
Keep your eyes peeled for him.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
那名侦察兵前往了魔物聚集的区域。
请留意他的动向。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Not bad! You guys....
Please eat three bowls of gongs!
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
干得不错！你们……
请吃三碗贡汤！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
A scout hasn't returned
from the Flaming Basin.
I want you to go check
what happened to him.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
一名侦察兵从烈焰盆地出发后就没有回来。
我想让你去查看一下他发生了什么。

scripts.text: No can do.
scripts.translation: 做不到。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
I know you'll do it anyway!
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
我知道你反正会去做的！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
The scout headed for the area teeming with monsters.
Keep your eyes peeled for him.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
那名侦察兵前往了魔物聚集的区域。
请留意他的动向。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
I sent you out to look for the scout.
Did you come back or haven't you left at all?
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
我派你们去找那名侦察兵。
你们到底是回来了，还是根本没出发？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Go look for the scout in the place teeming with monsters!
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
去魔物聚集的地方找那名侦察兵！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Did you find the scout?
He's resting and rewriting his scout journal?
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
你们找到那名侦察兵了吗？
他正在休息并重写侦察日志？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
He does not disappoint me.
He's a good soldier!
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
他真没让我失望。
他是个好士兵！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Now that we've found the missing scout,
I want you to move on to the next mission.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
既然找到了失踪的侦察兵，
我想让你们继续下一个任务。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
You know the number of mysterious monsters
in this Flaming Basin has been continuously increasing.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
你们知道，这片烈焰盆地中
神秘魔物的数量一直在持续增加。

scripts.text: I know.
scripts.translation: 我知道。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Things could quickly go out of control
if they expand to the outside world.
If they encounter other monsters in Midgard or the Other World,
they could go on a rampage,
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
如果它们扩散到外部世界，
局势很快就会失控。
如果它们在米德加尔特或异世界遇到其他魔物，
可能会大闹一场，

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
could spread deadly virus,
could procreate powerful mutants,
or worse.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
可能会传播致命病毒，
可能会繁殖出强大的变异体，
或者更糟糕的情况。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
For now, the best solution would be
a large cull, and I want you to do it.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
目前，最好的解决办法是
进行大规模清除，我想让你们去做。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Please exterminate
20 ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000
and ^0000FFFire Frilldoras^000000.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
请消灭
20只 ^0000FF火焰沙人^000000
和 ^0000FF火焰伞蜥^000000。

scripts.text: Do it yourself!
scripts.translation: 你自己去！

scripts.text: I'll do my best.
scripts.translation: 我会尽力。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
I hate to repeat myself,
but like everyone else from a noble background,
I only know how to command others.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
我不喜欢重复自己，
但和所有出身贵族的人一样，
我只知道如何命令别人。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Hurry, those monsters are breeding even as we speak.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
快一点，那些魔物此刻正在繁殖。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Please exterminate
20 ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000
and 20 ^0000FFFire Frilldoras^000000.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
请消灭
20只 ^0000FF火焰沙人^000000
和 20只 ^0000FF火焰伞蜥^000000。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
You exterminated
20 ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000
and 20 ^0000FFFire Frilldoras^000000 as I ordered.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
你们按照我的命令消灭了
20只 ^0000FF火焰沙人^000000
和 20只 ^0000FF火焰伞蜥^000000。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Thanks to you we've found an effective wayto deal with the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
多亏你们，我们找到了对付这些魔物的有效方法。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
From this moment on, my soldiers will take over.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
从这一刻起，将由我的士兵们接手。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Hurry, those monsters are
multiplying themselves even as we speak.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
快一点，那些魔物此刻正在不断繁殖。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Please exterminate
20 ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000
and 20 ^0000FFFire Frilldoras^000000.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
请消灭
20只 ^0000FF火焰沙人^000000
和 20只 ^0000FF火焰伞蜥^000000。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
So leave it to us to take care of this area, and you go ahead and head north.
I want you to do something about that strange group of people over there.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
所以这片区域就交给我们处理，你继续往北走。
我要你去处理一下那边那群奇怪的人。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
They've appeared out of nowhere.
doing everything they can to pester us.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
他们不知从哪里冒出来的，
变着法子来骚扰我们。

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with the dialogue because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续对话。 -

scripts.text:
[Scout]
I was sent to investigate these monsters.
It's unfair that I'm alone
in this dangerous place with no backup!
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
我是被派来调查这些魔物的。
在这个危险的地方，
没有支援却只有我一人，太不公平了！

scripts.text:
[Scout]
I was sent to investigate these monsters.
It's unfair that I'm alone
in this dangerous place with no backup!
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
我是被派来调查这些魔物的。
在这个危险的地方，
没有支援却只有我一人，太不公平了！

scripts.text:
[Scout]
Argh, I'm just gonna go AWOL!
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
啊，我干脆擅离职守算了！

scripts.text:
[Scout]
Welcome!
I'm in dire need of help!
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
欢迎！
我急需帮助！

scripts.text:
[Scout]
I came here alone on a recon mission.
A horde of monsters surrounded me, keeping me from leaving,
so I had no choice but to hang around.
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
我独自前来执行侦察任务。
一大群魔物包围了我，让我无法离开，
所以我只能留在这里。

scripts.text: Stay chilling then.
scripts.translation: 那就在这里休息吧。

scripts.text: Let's go back with me.
scripts.translation: 跟我一起回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
You're afraid I might ask for help,
I see.
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
看来你怕我会向你求助啊。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
I'm not injured, save a few scrapes,
but ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000 stole
my ^FF0000scout journal^000000.
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
我除了几处擦伤外并无大碍，
但 ^0000FF火焰沙人^000000 抢走了
我的 ^FF0000侦察日志^000000。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
Without the ^FF0000scout journal^000000, I can't go back.
I'll be lucky
if my superiors don't court-martial me.
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
没有 ^FF0000侦察日志^000000，我就无法回去。
如果上级不把我送上军事法庭，
我就谢天谢地了。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
Don't I sound pitiful?
Doesn't it inspire you to help me?
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
我听起来是不是很可怜？
这难道不能激发你帮助我的意愿吗？

scripts.text: Neh.
scripts.translation: 才没有。

scripts.text: It does.
scripts.translation: 确实能。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
All right, then I'll just have to
stay here and chill until help arrives.
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
好吧，那我就在这里休息，
直到救援到来。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
Okay, here's what you can do to help:
Please bring ^FF0000Scout Journals^000000
from ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000.
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
好的，你可以这样帮我：
请从 ^0000FF火焰沙人^000000 那里
带回 ^FF0000侦察日志^000000。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
The journal could have been separated into pages, snapped at by those feral monsters.
I don't care; I still need them to show to my superiors.
Please bring me
20 ^FF0000Scout Journals^000000.
scripts.translation:
